# Tokenizer reference fixtures

The vocabularies and input text are synthetic. Each pipeline contains all 256
byte symbols with permuted IDs, eight ranked merges, and six literal special
tokens. The Llama3 pipeline adds BOS/EOS through TemplateProcessing. The files
are generated by Hugging Face `tokenizers==0.22.2`, independently of the Go code.

To regenerate in an environment with that Python package installed:

```
python3 testdata/generate.py
```

`reference.json` records 1,056 exact encode/decode cases and 390 arbitrary-byte
decode cases. The generator uses a fixed random seed. `--qwen-dir DIR` also
writes reference cases beside an existing real Qwen `tokenizer.json` in DIR;
it does not download that file or place it in this repository.

Byte mapping and default splitting follow Hugging Face's ByteLevel implementation:
https://github.com/huggingface/tokenizers/blob/v0.22.2/tokenizers/src/pre_tokenizers/byte_level.rs

The Qwen pattern was verified from Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B at revision
`060db6499f32faf8b98477b0a26969ef7d8b9987`, tokenizer.json SHA-256
`c0382117ea329cdf097041132f6d735924b697924d6f6fc3945713e96ce87539`.
